high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the film "The Son," directed by Florian Zeller. The poster features a heartwarming scene of a man lifting a young child into the air, both appearing joyful and carefree against a backdrop of a bright, sunny sky with scattered clouds and a sparkling ocean. People: A man is holding a young child in his arms, lifting him up high. The man has short dark hair and is shirtless, wearing blue shorts. The child appears to be a toddler or young boy, also shirtless, with curly hair.
